name: IntegrateIT UniFi NVR HDMI
notes: Display-only Control4 AV source for the Ubiquiti UniFi NVR G2 HDMI live-view output. Exposes an HDMI OUT binding so the NVR feed can be routed through an AV matrix and selected in Watch. Controls nothing and reports nothing by design; the binding is the whole point. 3.1.0 additionally declares an experimental ONSCREEN_SELECTION room binding so the NVR can be offered as a room's On-Screen Device — untested against real hardware, and Control4 documents a precondition this source does not meet. Field-proven routing video on an AVPro Edge matrix; factory build adds self-update, validation, tests, and packaged docs the hand-built v1-v3 never had.
